GTA Online Weekly Update (November 12, 2026), Bonuses & Discounts

On this page, you can always stay up to date with the latest GTA Online weekly update, and the currently active GTA Online weekly bonuses and discounts. Every week, Rockstar Games introduces new GTA Online discounts, rewards, double and triple money activities, test rides, challenges, and exclusive event bonuses - and this guide tracks all of them in one place.

Here you find the current GTA weekly update active from November 12 to November 18, 2026, including all active bonuses in GTA Online, discounted vehicles and properties, the current GTA 5 Podium Vehicle and Prize Rides, Weekly Challenges, time-limited events, as well as the monthly GTA+ rewards and benefits.

This page is updated every week as soon as the new GTA Online weekly event goes live, making it the perfect page to bookmark and revisit for the newest GTA Online bonuses and rewards.
